items.question: Which vowel-syllables are assigned to the right and left cheeks?
premises: ekāraṃ is placed in the right cheek
aikāraṃ is placed in the left cheek
the verse pairs each syllable with a cheek
items.inference: The e-syllable belongs to the right cheek and the ai-syllable belongs to the left cheek.
uncertainties: exact morphological case of gaṇḍake is not fully resolved from the token alone
